Fuel consumption? Average fuel consumption 8.2L/100km. Convert to mpg. 8.2 L/100km = 100/8.2 = 12.195 km per liter. 1 gallon = 3.785 L. So km per gallon = 12.195*3.785 = 46.1 km/gallon. Miles per gallon = 46.1 km/gallon * 0.621371 = 28.6 mpg. For 750 miles, fuel needed = 750 / 28.6 = 26.2 gallons. Already have 10 gallons, so need 16.2 gallons. Let's round to 16.5 gallons.
